description: TapBot Commander Flagship on-device remote controller, device watchdog, and fleet manager for Android

userStories.title: Android Hardware Telemetry Service & Diagnostic DTOs
userStories.description: As a user, I want the bot to query physical device stats so I can inspect battery, RAM, storage, and network remotely via /status and /battery.
acceptanceCriteria: Create DeviceTelemetryProvider querying BatteryManager, ActivityManager (RAM), StatFs (disk), and ConnectivityManager
Implement formatted text output with battery health, temperature, charging state, and Doze whitelist status
Unit test DeviceTelemetryProvider with mocked Android managers
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: DeviceTelemetryProvider implemented and tested with 42 unit tests passing.

userStories.title: Remote Android Hardware Actions Controller
userStories.description: As a user, I want to trigger phone actions via Telegram so I can find my misplaced phone with /ring, toggle flashlight with /torch, and send notifications with /notify.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement DeviceActionController using AudioManager (Ringtone alert with max volume), CameraManager (Torch toggle), and Vibrator
Implement owner authentication checking Telegram numeric user_id against configured owner_id
Add safety timeout auto-silencing the ringtone after 15 seconds or via /stopring
Unit test action handlers and owner gating
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: DeviceActionController implemented with AudioManager, CameraManager, and Vibrator, owner auth checks, safety auto-silencing, and full unit test coverage.

userStories.title: Fleet Command Router & In-Telegram Bot Management
userStories.description: As a user, I want to control my TapBot fleet remotely via Telegram commands (/bots, /startbot, /stopbot, /restartbot, /logs).
acceptanceCriteria: Wire BotInstanceManager to CommanderBotRuntime command dispatch
/bots returns real-time status list with emojis and poll counts
/logs <bot_id> [lines] returns the last N sanitized log lines from LogRepository
Unit test fleet commands with mock BotInstanceManager
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Autonomous Background Watchdog Coroutine
userStories.description: As a user, I want autonomous Telegram push alerts when the host phone battery drops below 15% or when any bot crashes.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement DeviceWatchdog running periodic background checks in CommanderBotRuntime
Trigger urgent Telegram message to owner_id if battery < threshold and discharging
Listen to BotInstanceManager crash events and immediately push crash notification with error message
Debounce battery alerts to avoid spamming (minimum 30 minutes between warnings)
Unit test watchdog threshold detection and debouncing
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: In-Chat Direct APK Document Delivery (/apk)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to download the latest installed TapBot APK directly in Telegram by typing /apk.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement Telegram sendDocument multipart upload reading the app's base.apk via context.applicationInfo.sourceDir
Compute SHA-256 integrity checksum and format in caption message
Handle file size limit gracefully with clear user error message if APK exceeds Telegram 50MB bot upload limit
Unit test APK file resolver and checksum generation
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
